{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000003N3JN2PTA449N","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group client "@dxos/echo-client" {
  node Result "QueryResultImpl" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/query-result.ts"
  node Engine "LocalQueryEngine" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/local-query-engine.ts"
  node WorkingSet "WorkingSetView" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/working-set-view.ts"
  node Registry "RegistryView" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/registry-view.ts"
  node Plan "merge-plan" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/merge-plan.ts"
  node Remote "RemoteQuerySource" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/query/remote-query-source.ts"
  node Index "IndexQuerySource" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client/src/client/index-query-source-provider.ts"
}
group host "@dxos/echo-host" {
  node Service "QueryServiceImpl" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/query-service.ts"
  node Executor "QueryExecutor" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/query/query-executor.ts"
  node Sql "SqlPlanCompiler" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/query/sql/compile.ts"
}
group core "@dxos/index-core" {
  node Snapshots "ObjectSnapshotIndex" ref="packages/core/echo/index-core/src/indexes/object-snapshot-index.ts"
}
edge Result -> Engine
edge Engine owns WorkingSet
edge Engine owns Registry
edge Engine -> Plan "verdicts"
edge Engine -> Remote
edge Index implements Remote
edge Index -> Service "QueryService"
edge Service -> Executor
edge Executor -> Sql
edge Executor -> Snapshots "index copies"
